summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; extends ADR-0044 and complements ADR-0037, ADR-0041, ADR-0043; repository source and accepted ADRs are authoritative, projections/indexes derived_cache only; deterministic locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence, never synthesized facts; callers must reread and hash-verify; trusted adapters enforce domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence envelopes and untrusted LLM intent cannot widen them; VDD records post-reread accept/reject decisions, rejected candidates cannot satisfy required modules, uncovered modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses only VDD-frozen decisions; Bootstrap Review may locate before prepare and freezes context in Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback default off and approved fallback only via scripts/sc/_llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins local refs/heads/main, no implicit fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation, only derived artifacts and append-only evidence; failures for missing/stale/low-confidence/out-of-policy/hash drift fail closed; no authorization for routes, Hosted E2 dispatch, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, or commit
